items.title: What Sauna Research Actually Shows About Longevity
items.summary: Sauna is one of the longevity practices I use consistently, but the evidence needs to be described honestly. The widely shared reductions in mortality, cardiovascular events, and dementia come largely from observational Finnish data, not randomized trials proving sauna caused those outcomes. The research is still compelling enough to take seriously, especially around cardiovascular conditioning and heat adaptation, but it is not a guarantee. I also track my own toxic-burden results and have seen lower levels during periods when I use sauna. That is useful personal data, not proof that sauna “detoxes” everyone. My approach is to separate established evidence, promising associations, and personal response. Hydration, heat tolerance, medical conditions, and recovery still matter more than chasing the hottest temperature or longest session. #Sauna #Longevity #HeatTherapy #CardiovascularHealth #HealthyAging

items.title: Glucagon Explained: The Peptide Behind Retatrutide’s Secret Weapon
items.summary: What if one of the most important peptides in your body does almost the OPPOSITE of insulin? It's called glucagon. Insulin helps lower blood sugar. Glucagon can help raise it — and it's so powerful that glucagon is used as an emergency medicine for severe low blood sugar. But that's only part of the story. Scientists are now targeting the glucagon system alongside GLP-1 and GIP in retatrutide, an experimental triple-receptor agonist producing remarkable results in human trials. In this video, we break down: What glucagon is and how it works Why glucagon can raise blood sugar How glucagon differs from insulin Why glucagon is an established medicine Why scientists would target glucagon for weight loss How retatrutide targets GLP-1 + GIP + glucagon The human evidence behind retatrutide Why “glucagon is the opposite of insulin” is useful — but an oversimplification In a Phase 2 trial, the highest retatrutide dose produced 24.2% average weight loss at 48 weeks. More recently, Lilly reported 28.3% average weight loss at 80 weeks at the highest dose in its Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1 trial. Retatrutide remains investigational and is not currently FDA approved. 🔬 Peptide A to Z Research. Education. items.title: Thymosin Alpha-1 may be one of the most studied peptides you’ve never heard of.
items.summary: While many popular peptides have limited human evidence, Thymosin Alpha-1 has been investigated across 30+ clinical studies involving more than 11,000 human subjects. Researchers have explored its effects on the immune system, serious infections, cancer, and other immune-related conditions. But one of the largest trials produced a surprising result. In this video, we break down: 🔬 What Thymosin Alpha-1 actually is 🛡️ Why it's called an “immune peptide” 👥 The research involving 11,000+ human subjects 📊 What earlier studies appeared to show ⚠️ What happened in a 1,106-person Phase 3 sepsis trial 🧬 What the human evidence actually tells us Is Thymosin Alpha-1 really an immune peptide — or have the claims gotten ahead of the evidence? items.title: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. items.title: I Brought 15 Gut Tests to a GI Doctor. He Dismissed All of Them
items.summary: I brought in my gut testing, circled everything that was out of range, and explained exactly what had changed after antibiotics. The response was that my calprotectin and colonoscopy looked fine, so the rest of the data was dismissed, even though I was still symptomatic. This is exactly why looking beyond a single marker can matter when symptoms are still there. #GutHealth #Microbiome #WomensHealth #FunctionalMedicine #FemaleLongevity

items.title: This Brain Game May Cut Dementia Risk by 30%
items.summary: Reaction time may reveal more about brain aging than most people realize. Speed-of-processing training has been studied in a long-term randomized controlled trial, with evidence suggesting that it may reduce dementia risk by as much as 30%. Brain training is not just about memory. How quickly the brain processes information may also matter. #DementiaPrevention #BrainTraining #ReactionTime #CognitiveHealth #Longevity

items.title: What Birth Control Actually Does To Your Bone Density
items.summary: Birth control is one of the most common questions in women's health, and the decision is never one-size-fits-all. Hormonal birth control suppresses natural estrogen and progesterone production, which over time can affect bone density, something rarely explained at the point of prescription. This isn't about telling anyone to stop taking it. It's about making the decision an informed one, including lower-hormone options and how to support bone health if staying on it. #WomensHealth #FemaleLongevity #BirthControl #HormoneHealth #BoneHealth #WomensWellness #LongevityTips

items.title: Biomarker Series: The Number That Drops 10% A Year After 30
items.summary: VO2 max is one of the strongest predictors of long-term health available right now, and it's measurable at multiple levels of precision. A wearable like Whoop gives a rough estimate, an at-home device adds another layer of accuracy, and in-clinic diagnostics remain the gold standard for anyone who wants the most precise number. Without consistent VO2 max training, this number can decline by about 10% per year after age 30, which makes it one of the more urgent metrics to track and train against, not just observe. #VO2Max #FemaleLongevity #CardioFitness #Biomarkers #LongevitySeries #WomensHealth #FitnessOverForty
